title: What Your Reps Hear That Your Analytics Never Will
content:
###  **The Data No Platform Provides** 

Analytics tell you what happened. They do not tell you why. A form that was never submitted, a quote that was never accepted, a homeowner who chose a competitor — none of that leaves a trace you can read. 

Homeowners will explain all of it at their own front door. They will say who else quoted them and roughly what it cost. They will say what made them hesitate. They will say what they thought your company did and did not do. 

###  **What Comes Back From the Field** 

Over a week of conversations in a territory, patterns emerge — what competitors are quoting locally, why past quotes did not convert, which objections repeat, how a brand is actually perceived, and which services homeowners ask about that a company may not be promoting. 

###  **Naming It** 

We are calling this SIT™ Field Intelligence, and it is included with every territory program. Each weekly report includes what representatives heard, not only what they did. 

###  **Why It Is Included Rather Than Sold** 

It is a byproduct of work already being done. Charging separately for something that arrives on its own would be difficult to justify. 

###  **The Condition** 

Field Intelligence is only valuable to a company willing to act on it. Feedback that confirms what you already believe is pleasant. Feedback that contradicts it is the useful kind — and it is only useful if something changes as a result.
